llm_response.reason: The domain ad.flacconi.com was registered in April 2025 and mimics the legitimate and well-known beauty shop flaconi.de, suggesting an intent to deceive. The site lacks proper legal and contact information, has broken hyperlinks, and provides no verifiable company credentials, which are common requirements in the German e-commerce sector. The product selection and branding further suggest an attempt to impersonate a legitimate online shop for fraudulent purposes. These factors match several characteristics of scam sites: spoofing of legitimate brands, ambiguous or missing business information, new and hidden registration data, and technical indicators of an unprofessional, likely fraudulent operation.
